subject: Portal profile grooming & evidence inventory sprint
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Ruiz <dan@brightleaf.com>, Vendr Security Ops <security_ops@vendr.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal profile grooming & evidence inventory sprint

Hi Daniel / Vendr team,

Thanks again for agreeing to start the portal onboarding cleanup. Brightleaf's procurement team asked us to consolidate the security profile and rotate stale evidence before their Q3 audit. To keep this scoped and actionable, I propose a short "profile grooming" sprint focused on OneTrust + Vendr entries that map to our SOC 2 / CAIQ / SIG artifacts.

Proposed sprint (2 weeks):
- Goal: reconcile Brightleaf entries in portal(s) with our canonical evidence and fill gaps for CAIQ/SIG controls.
- Owners: Brightleaf (Daniel) — evidence upload; Redwood — control mapping + verification (Karthik); Portal work (Vendr ops) — API assist for bulk uploads.
- Kickoff: Mon Jun 22, 10:00 PT (30 min)
- Deliverables: evidence manifest (CSV) with file locations, CAIQ mapping workbook, list of any required attestations.

Attached: brightleaf_evidence_manifest.csv (initial inventory) — Daniel, can you confirm the items marked as "pending" and add file links? We will use the mapping workbook to align each item to CAIQ control IDs.

Notes / asks for Vendr team:
- Can you enable a temporary upload token for bulk ingestion and set retention to 90 days for the sprint artifacts?
- Any rate limits we should know about for a bulk import of ~250 files?

Next steps: Daniel to confirm manifest by Friday; Redwood to run a first-pass CAIQ mapping and share redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx ahead of kickoff.

Thanks — feel free to suggest alternate timing.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: brightleaf_evidence_manifest.csv (CSV)]

From: Daniel Ruiz <dan@brightleaf.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendr Security Ops <security_ops@vendr.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal profile grooming & evidence inventory sprint

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear plan.

I reviewed the manifest and updated ~40 items with direct S3 links; the rest are marked "with legal" or "archiving." Vendr team — we've given Redwood read access to the staging bucket (s3://brightleaf-audit/stage) and plan to open upload access next Tue.

Quick notes:
- We have an internal mapping table that links our audit artifacts to CAIQ IDs; I attached a small export (see inline list) — happy to share the full mapping after kickoff.
- We confirmed there are ~220 unique files to ingest, average size 1.4MB.
- Vendr, please confirm bulk upload token and recommended chunk size.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal profile grooming & evidence inventory sprint

Aisha / Monica — I ran a first-pass on the manifest and started populating the CAIQ mapping workbook (redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx). High-level findings:

- Coverage: ~60% of manifest items clearly map to CAIQ control IDs (primarily identity, logging, and encryption controls).
- Gaps: vendor-supplied penetration test reports are missing for three subcomponents; some SOC 2 evidence references are archived behind legal hold.
- Quality issues: several PDFs are scans with low OCR quality — we should request native exports where possible.

Suggested action items before kickoff:
1) Daniel: please prioritize the three pentest reports and mark ETA in the manifest.
2) Monica: confirm Redwood's canonical doc store link to be used in the portal links column (we'll reference https://redwoodinc.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/Security/EV123 unless you want a different store).
3) Vendr: recommend doing the bulk upload in 5 concurrent worker threads, 50 files per chunk — should stay under their 10MB/sec per-connection limit.

I'll consolidate my notes into the mapping workbook tonight.

—Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Daniel Ruiz <dan@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Vendr Security Ops <security_ops@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal profile grooming & evidence inventory sprint — kickoff confirmed

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation note:

- Kickoff: Mon Jun 22, 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to all parties (30 min).
- Owners: Daniel — evidence delivery and link verification; Karthik — CAIQ mapping and sample verification on first 25 files; Monica (me) — portal ingestion tracker + acceptance checks.
- Acceptance criteria for sprint artifacts: each uploaded file must include: source link, SHA256 checksum, CAIQ control ID(s) mapping, and upload timestamp.
- Escalation path: any missing pentest reports or legal holds — escalate to procurement@brightleaf.com and loop in Aisha.

Vendr team — please confirm the upload token and concurrency settings by EOD so we can run a smoke test Tuesday morning.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sprint_kickoff_agenda.pdf (PDF)]
